sources.entry: ClaudeTTY - Native macOS terminal for running lots of Claude Code at once, where every tab keeps running after the app quits. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/aqilc/ClaudeTTY) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: ClaudeTTY is a native macOS terminal app for running many Claude Code sessions at once, where each tab runs in a zmx session that survives app quits and crashes.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a macOS terminal built for running many Claude Code sessions. Each tab runs in a zmx session outside the app, so sessions persist through quits, crashes, updates and reboots (tabs are restored with claude --resume). Tabs are organized into color-codable, pinnable groups in a sidebar, with iTerm-style splits and panes. Tab icons (Dots or Clawd) indicate when a session needs input and show context usage. Idle tabs can be put to sleep to save memory, and a bundled 'ct' command plus a Claude Code plugin let one Claude session list, open, split, wait on and send input to other tabs. The author says the app is written in about 8,500 lines of Swift across 3 files, built with Zig and GhosttyKit.
use_cases: run several Claude Code sessions side by side
keep long coding agent sessions alive across app quits
organize projects into groups of terminal tabs
let one Claude session control other terminal tabs
lightweight macOS terminal alternative to cmux
schedule a prompt for when usage limits reset
how_to_run: Download ClaudeTTY.dmg, open it and drag ClaudeTTY to Applications.
Build from source: install Xcode and Zig 0.16 (brew install zig@0.16).
./deps.sh (builds GhosttyKit from pinned, patched Ghostty source and fetches zmx)
notable: Tabs persist in zmx sessions outside the app, so quitting or crashing doesn't kill running Claude Code sessions
Chrome-style tab sleeping after 20 idle minutes, with waking into the same session
ct command and Claude Code plugin let one Claude session open, watch and steer other tabs
One shared copy of each MCP server across all tabs
Dots or Clawd tab icons turn amber when a session needs attention
caveats: Requires macOS 26 or later and Apple Silicon
Building from source needs Xcode and Zig 0.16
